title: Company commander’s rifle inspection — San Diego, late summer 1960
credit: Photo and caption supplied by Brent; original contributor and photographer unidentified
note: Date and location follow the supplied caption. Earlier-period recruit-training context, not a 1965–66 photograph.
originalCaption: Marine Corps Boot Camp (recruit training) at San Diego, California in late summer 1960. Company Commander's rifle inspection, the first three squads, left front into line. By this time, maybe 5 weeks into it, we were pretty "squared away" as recruits. Full basic training consisted of 17 weeks, including 13 weeks of basic recruit training and 4 weeks of advanced infantry training with weapons. In this picture I am the first recruit on the right.
researchNote: First-person identity unknown; do not attribute to Brent. Training-duration recollection not independently verified and not applied to 1965–66.
